/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Processes a move request from the user, updating game state counters and the move stack.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. result = gameState.getGameBoardController().makeMove(direction).
 *   2. If result is Invalid: return Invalid (no counters changed, not pushed to stack).
 *   3. If result is Dead:
 *      - gameState.incrementNumMoves().
 *      - gameState.incrementNumDeaths().
 *      - If not gameState.hasUnlimitedLives(): gameState.decrementNumLives().
 *      - Do not push to moveStack.
 *      - Return result.
 *   4. If result is Alive:
 *      - gameState.incrementNumMoves().
 *      - For each ExtraLife collected: gameState.increaseNumLives(1).
 *      - Push result to gameState.moveStack.
 *      - Return result.
 * Related Features: gameState, gameState.moveStack, makeMove()
 * Related Classes: GameState, GameBoardController, MoveStack, MoveResult, Alive, Dead, Invalid, Direction
 * Input: direction - a Direction enum value.
 * Output: MoveResult - the result of the move.
 * Pre-condition: direction is not null; gameState is initialized.
 * Post-condition: Counters updated according to result type; Alive moves pushed to stack.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public MoveResult processMove(final Direction direction)
{
    MoveResult result = gameState.getGameBoardController().makeMove(direction);
    
    if (result instanceof Invalid) {
        return result;
    }
    
    if (result instanceof Dead) {
        gameState.incrementNumMoves();
        gameState.incrementNumDeaths();
        if (!gameState.hasUnlimitedLives()) {
            gameState.decrementNumLives();
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    // result is Alive
    gameState.incrementNumMoves();
    Alive aliveResult = (Alive) result;
    for (Position extraLifePos : aliveResult.getCollectedExtraLives()) {
        gameState.increaseNumLives(1);
    }
    gameState.getMoveStack().push(result);
    return result;
}

   *         - Else, set newPosition = currentPos, break loop (stop before Wall).
   *      e. If cell is StopCell:
   *         - Set moved = true, newPosition = nextPos, break loop (stop exactly on StopCell).
   *      f. If cell is EntityCell:
   *         - entity = cell.entity.
   *         - If entity is Mine: 
   *           - Return Dead with minePosition = nextPos, newPosition = original player position (before any movement).
   *         - If entity is Gem: add nextPos to collectedGems, remove Gem from board (set cell.entity = null).
   *         - If entity is ExtraLife: add nextPos to collectedExtraLives, remove ExtraLife from board.
   *         - Set moved = true, currentPos = nextPos.
   *      g. If cell is plain EntityCell with no entity (null): moved = true, currentPos = nextPos, continue.
   *   5. After loop, if moved is false, return Invalid.
   *   6. Update player position to newPosition.
   *   7. Return Alive with newPosition = newPosition, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives.
   * Related Features: gameBoard, gameBoard.player, gameBoard.getCell(), Direction
   * Related Classes: GameBoard, Position, Direction, MoveResult, Alive, Dead, Invalid, Wall, StopCell, EntityCell, Gem, ExtraLife, Mine, Player
   * Input: direction - a Direction enum value (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT)
   * Output: MoveResult - Alive (with collected items and new position), Dead (with mine position), or Invalid.
   * Pre-condition: direction is not null; gameBoard and player are initialized.
   * Post-condition: For Alive moves: player position is updated to newPosition; collected Gems and ExtraLives are removed from the board; score-related counters are updated accordingly. For Dead moves: player position remains at the original position; board is unchanged; no Gems or ExtraLives are collected. For Invalid moves: nothing changes.

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction) {
    // Get player's current position
    Position playerPos = gameBoard.getPlayer().getOwner().getPosition();
    int origRow = playerPos.getRow();
    int origCol = playerPos.getCol();
    
    // Determine delta from Direction
    int dRow, dCol;
    switch (direction) {
        case UP:
            dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
        case DOWN:
            dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
        case LEFT:
            dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
        case RIGHT:
            dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
        default:
            return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }
    
    Position currentPos = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
    currentPos.setRow(origRow);
    currentPos.setCol(origCol);
    
    boolean moved = false;
    EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
    EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
    Position newPosition = null;
    
    int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
    int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
    
    while (true) {
        Position nextPos = currentPos.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
        int nextRow = nextPos.getRow();
        int nextCol = nextPos.getCol();
        
        // Check out of bounds
        if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= numRows || nextCol < 0 || nextCol >= numCols) {
            if (!moved) {
                return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
            } else {
                newPosition = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
                newPosition.setRow(currentPos.getRow());
                newPosition.setCol(currentPos.getCol());
                break;
            }
        }
        
        Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(nextPos);
        
        if (cell instanceof Wall) {
            if (!moved) {
                return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
            } else {
                newPosition = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
                newPosition.setRow(currentPos.getRow());
                newPosition.setCol(currentPos.getCol());
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (cell instanceof StopCell) {
            moved = true;
            newPosition = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
            newPosition.setRow(nextRow);
            newPosition.setCol(nextCol);
            break;
        }
        
        if (cell instanceof EntityCell) {
            EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell) cell;
            Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
            
            if (entity instanceof Mine) {
                Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
                Position minePos = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
                minePos.setRow(nextRow);
                minePos.setCol(nextCol);
                dead.setMinePosition(minePos);
                dead.setNewPosition(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition());
                dead.getNewPosition().setRow(origRow);
                dead.getNewPosition().setCol(origCol);
                dead.setOrigPosition(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition());
                dead.getOrigPosition().setRow(origRow);
                dead.getOrigPosition().setCol(origCol);
                return dead;
            }
            
            if (entity instanceof Gem) {
                Position gemPos = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
                gemPos.setRow(nextRow);
                gemPos.setCol(nextCol);
                collectedGems.add(gemPos);
                entityCell.setEntity(null);
            }
            
            if (entity instanceof ExtraLife) {
                Position lifePos = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createPosition();
                lifePos.setRow(nextRow);
                lifePos.setCol(nextCol);
                collectedExtraLives.add(lifePos);
                entityCell.setEntity(null);
            }
            
            moved = true;
            currentPos.setRow(nextRow);
            currentPos.setCol(nextCol);
            continue;
        }
        
        // Plain EntityCell with no entity (null)
        moved = true;
        currentPos.setRow(nextRow);
        currentPos.setCol(nextCol);
    }
    
    if (!moved) {
        return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }
    
    // Update player position to newPosition
    EntityCell oldOwner = gameBoard.getPlayer().getOwner();
    if (oldOwner != null) {
        oldOwner.setEntity(null);
    }
    EntityCell newOwner = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(newPosition);
    if (newOwner != null) {
        newOwner.setEntity(gameBoard.getPlayer());
    }

public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
    Alive alive = (Alive) prevMove;
    
    // Set player position to origPosition
    Position origPos = alive.getOrigPosition();
    EntityCell oldOwner = gameBoard.getPlayer().getOwner();
    if (oldOwner != null) {
        oldOwner.setEntity(null);
    }
    EntityCell newOwner = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(origPos);
    if (newOwner != null) {
        newOwner.setEntity(gameBoard.getPlayer());
    }
    
    // Restore collected Gems
    for (Position gemPos : alive.getCollectedGems()) {
        EntityCell cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gemPos);
        if (cell != null) {
            cell.setEntity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
        }
    }
    
    // Restore collected ExtraLives
    for (Position lifePos : alive.getCollectedExtraLives()) {
        EntityCell cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lifePos);
        if (cell != null) {
            cell.setEntity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
        }
    }
}

    int origCol = playerPos.getCol();

    int dRow, dCol;
    switch (direction) {

        dCol = 0;
        break;
      case DOWN:
        dRow = 1;
        dCol = 0;
        break;
      case LEFT:
